partner_result.application: Retained the partner whitening/physical-block conditioning identity and generalized the Brascamp-Lieb weights from canonical leverages to an alternative half-capped isotropic scaling.

new_claim.statement: If the normalized rows of a whitened rank-r physical factor admit weights theta_i in [0,1/2] with sum theta_i v_i v_i^T=I_r, then arbitrary coordinate-separable perturbations have bounded continuous quadratic-form density with explicit B_theta determinant bound.

exact_example: Rows sqrt(4/5)e1, sqrt(1/5)e1, e2/sqrt2 twice, e3/sqrt2 twice fail both the canonical max-leverage<=1/2 test and the partner one-heavy conditioning test, but theta_i=1/2 is isotropic and gives density constant 3*10^(1/3)|det Lambda|^(-1/3).
next_step: Use the fractional weights together with the regularized cross-block determinant theorem to build an aggregated three-direction coordinate split or identify a frame whose every half-capped isotropic scaling has unbounded KL cost.
